shared_elements: incised linear motifs on a rock/stone surface
possible boat-like curved form with attached short strokes
repeated short vertical strokes in a row
justification: The clearest possible correspondence is a curved hull-like line topped with a row of short repeated strokes, present unambiguously in B and arguably in the lower zone of A, plus the general use of incised outline figures. Otherwise the content is very different: A is a framed, modelled composition of large standing/kneeling human figures facing one another with headdresses, offerings and rows of sign-like glyphs, while B shows only flat, purely schematic repeated craft-and-stroke motifs scattered across an open surface with no interacting figures.
